name: Spike fall: walking across a flush spike patch the ground rays can't stand on
techNote: A floor (top y 0) with a 96-wide spike patch (layer 6, spikeScript; x 0-96) flush with its top where the floor tiles would be. Spikes are triggers, not ground: the ground rays (x-15, x+6, x+25 facing right, reaching y-40) find nothing once the back one passes x 0 and before the front one reaches x 96. Running at 460 the dot stands (the hurtbox's bottom, y-27, is 7 u above a floor-level spike) until the rays lose the floor on tick 22; then it starts to fall (coyote keeps onGround for 6 ticks) and the hurtbox sinks into the patch on tick 28 (spike2 *0, free). On tick 29 the front ray's 5-u probe finds the far floor and Movement's step-up (+10) lifts the dot onto it (spike2 1: the Stay counted 1, inside graceFrames 1), so a flush patch up to 100 u wide is walkable at full speed; 104 u dies on the 2nd Stay. The finish box is on the far floor, no jump anywhere. Ghost: stop (stick released as the rays leave the floor: it falls into the patch and dies on the 3rd tick).

ghosts.label: Spike fall: run across, 2 ticks in the spikes, lifted onto the far floor
